text.en:
Item D-173.7, for the Province of Cebu, page 934-A of Republic Act Numbered Sixteen hundred thirteen, is amended to read as follows:
Proposed priority Project number Name and location of project Finance method Total estimated cost in Total for 5 years Year in which expenditure is needed for 1956-57 1957-58 1958-59 1959-60 1960-61 ₱1,000 ₱1,000 ₱1,000 ₱1,000 ₱1,000 ₱1,000 ₱1,000 Carcar Waterworks GR
25.00
25.00
25.00 Cantabaco-Naga Waterworks GR
10.00 Can-Asujan Waterworks, Carcar GR
15.00

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1959.
